svg.text: K5b KNIFE CAGE — one turn of P0 is one cut
A blade bridge stands on the turning ring round the pot; the ram advances one slice thickness per turn, the blade cuts it off.
blade sweeps r 10–135 mm · die face spans r 10–121 mm
slice 1–20 mm = ram advance per revolution
torque for a full potato face ≈ 6 Nm (P0 has 20 Nm)
cage Ø 300 × 230, open-sided, driven by the ring's pins
cage ring Ø 300 stands on the P0 carrier ring
die 100 × 100, centre 60 mm in front of the axis
blade sweeps r 10–135; face spans r 10–121:
the slow centre lies outside the die face
the cage goes to the dishwasher
the one turntable motor of P0

g.text: 1/3 Potatoes stand in the tube on the open-mouth cassette; the knife cage stands on the P0 ring round the pot
2/3 P0 turns: each pass of the sickle under the die cuts one slice; the foot advances 6 mm per turn, so slices are 6 mm
3/3 Slices have dropped through the conical collar into the pot below — no tray, no transfer
